paper_title: Leading Axion-Photon Sensitivity with NuSTAR Observations of M82 and M87
notes: Astrophysical (stellar Primakoff production + magnetic conversion) bound on axion-photon coupling from NuSTAR observations of M82. Main quoted 95% CL limit: |g_agamma| <= 6.4e-13 GeV^-1 for m_a <= 1e-10 eV (M82, strongest); M87 gives 8.4e-13 GeV^-1. Bound is essentially flat for low masses and rises above ~1e-10 eV up to ~1e-9 eV (exact mass-dependent curve only shown in Fig.2, not tabulated in text). Encoded flat portion as horizontal line spanning validity range.
